question: Who defeated Mohammad Ghori in the First Battle of Tarain fought in the year 1191?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Prithviraj Chauhan__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **First Battle of Tarain (1191):**

 
 
• Participants: Prithviraj Chauhan vs. Muhammad of Ghori.
 
• Outcome:** Victory for Prithviraj Chauhan.**
 
 
 
• **Second Battle of Tarain (1192):**
 
 
• Participants: Prithviraj Chauhan vs. Muhammad of Ghori.
 
• Outcome: **Decisive victory for Muhammad of Ghori.**
 
• Consequence: Prithviraj Chauhan was captured and executed; **established Muslim rule in northern India.**
 
• Significance:
 
 
• **Paved the way for the Delhi Sultanate.**
 
• **Qutb-ud-din Aibak, Muhammad of Ghori's former slave, **founded the Mamluk Dynasty in 1206, establishing the first Delhi Sultanate.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vasudeva** founded the** Kanva Dynasty.**
 
• **Overthrew** the **last Shunga kin**g around 75 BCE.
 
• Ruled parts of northern and central India.
 
• **Yashovarman of Kannauj**: 8th-century king, **founded Varman dynasty**, military conquests, patron of arts, defeated Bengal ruler.
 
• **Vidyadhar: **11th-century ruler of **Chandela dynasty**, fortified Khajuraho temples, resisted Ghaznavid invasions, patron of architecture.
